description:
[Deterministic corporate valuation engine. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) enterprise valuation model: Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) Cost of Equity, after-tax Cost of Debt, blended Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), Gordon Growth perpetual terminal value, net debt bridge waterfall, and multi-parameter sensitivity matrix.
Usage: Use this tool to calculate intrinsic Enterprise Value, Equity Value, and implied share price from forecast cash flows. Do NOT use for solvency default prediction (use 'corporate_default_predictor') or accounting anomaly forensics (use 'financial_trend_anomaly').
Returns: JSON object with { enterpriseValue: number, equityValue: number, impliedSharePrice: number | null, wacc: number, costOfEquity: number, costOfDebtAfterTax: number, pvForecastFlows: number, terminalValue: number, sensitivityMatrix: Array<{ wacc, terminalGrowth, enterpriseValue }> }.

forecastCashFlows.description: At least 2 projection periods of forecast FCFF

fcff.description: Free Cash Flow to Firm in EUR

netDebtBridge.description: Balance sheet net debt bridge to calculate Equity Value

cashAndCashEquivalents.description: Cash and liquid equivalents in EUR

sharesOutstanding.description: Total diluted shares for implied share price calculation

name: dcf_wacc_valuation
